levels.1: Simple retrieval — find/filter on one collection, no aggregation
levels.2: Filter + sort / count — single collection with operators
levels.5: Complex multi-step — chained $lookup, sub-pipelines, or derived metrics

questions.question: Show all active customers.
Find all branches located in Maharashtra.
List all customers whose KYC status is 'pending'.
Show all loans that are currently defaulted.
List all merchants in the 'dining' category.
Show all credit cards that are currently blocked.
questions.hint: Filter cards where card_type = 'credit' and status = 'blocked'.

questions.question: Find all support tickets with critical priority.
List all fraud alerts that are still open.
Show all investments with a negative return.
List all employees in the 'Fraud & Risk' department.
Which customers have an annual income above ₹10 lakh, sorted by income descending?
questions.hint: Match annual_income > 1000000, sort by annual_income descending.

questions.question: Find the top 10 accounts with the highest balance.
How many transactions failed in 2024?
List all high-risk customers who are currently blocked.
Show all RTGS transactions above ₹10 lakh, sorted by amount descending.
How many active home loans are there?
Which merchants have processed more than 10,000 transactions?
List all dormant accounts opened before 2020.
Find all support tickets raised via email that are still open or in progress.
Which employees have a performance rating above 4.5?
What is the average balance of savings accounts?
What is the total transaction amount per month in 2025?
questions.hint: $match year=2025, $group by month using $month on transaction_date, $sum amount.

questions.question: How many customers are there in each risk category?
What is the average loan interest rate by loan type?
Which transaction category has the highest total spend?
What is the total outstanding loan amount per loan type?
How many transactions were made through each channel (UPI, NEFT, RTGS, etc.)?
What is the maximum credit limit among all credit cards?
What is the average credit score of customers who have defaulted loans?
questions.hint: $group customers who appear in loans with status='defaulted', $avg credit_score — needs $lookup or prior match.

questions.question: How many support tickets are there per priority level?
Which customers have active personal loans? Show their name and outstanding amount.
questions.hint: $match loans where loan_type='personal' and status='active', $lookup customers, $project name + outstanding_amount.

questions.question: List all transactions made at dining merchants, along with the merchant name.
questions.hint: $lookup merchants on merchant_id, $match category='dining' or merchant.category='dining'.

questions.question: Which branch has sanctioned the highest total loan amount?
questions.hint: $group loans by sanctioning_branch_id sum principal_amount, $sort desc, $limit 1, $lookup branches.

questions.question: Which customers have an open fraud alert? Show customer name, alert type, and risk score.
Find customers who have more than 2 active accounts.
questions.hint: $group accounts by customer_id counting active ones, $match count > 2, $lookup customers.

questions.question: Which customers have never taken any loan?
questions.hint: Get customer_ids from loans, use $lookup or $nin in customers not present in loans collection.

questions.question: Which accounts have had no transactions in the last 6 months?
questions.hint: $group transactions to get last transaction per account, $lookup accounts, filter where last_transaction_date < 6 months ago, OR use last_transaction_date field on accounts.

questions.question: What is the total transaction amount per customer for the year 2025? Show top 10 customers.
questions.hint: $match 2025 dates, $group by customer_id $sum amount, $sort desc, $limit 10, $lookup customers for names.

questions.question: List all fraud alerts along with the transaction amount and account number of the flagged transaction.
questions.hint: $lookup transactions on transaction_id, $lookup accounts on account_id.

questions.question: Which employees have managed the most support tickets? Show top 5.
Which customers with active personal loans made more than 5 transactions in the last 3 months?
questions.hint: 1) Filter active personal loans → get customer_ids. 2) Filter transactions in last 3 months for those customers. 3) Group by customer_id, count. 4) Filter count > 5. 5) Join customers for names.

questions.question: Which branch has the highest average account balance? Show branch name, city, and average balance.
questions.hint: $group accounts by branch_id $avg balance, $sort desc, $limit 1, $lookup branches.

questions.question: For each merchant category, what is the total transaction volume and average transaction amount in 2024?
questions.hint: $match 2024 + non-null merchant_id, $lookup merchants, $group by merchant.category, $sum amount, $avg amount.

questions.question: Which customers have both a defaulted loan and an open fraud alert?
questions.hint: Get customer_ids from defaulted loans, intersect with customer_ids from open fraud_alerts, $lookup customers.

questions.question: What is the month-over-month transaction count for UPI payments in 2025?
questions.hint: $match UPI + year 2025, $group by {year, month}, $sum 1, $sort by month.

questions.question: Which customers have investments with returns above 20% and also have an active loan?
questions.hint: Get customer_ids from investments where returns_percentage > 20. Intersect with active loan customers. Join customers.

questions.question: For each loan officer, how many loans have they approved, and what is the total outstanding amount of their portfolio?
questions.hint: $group loans by loan_officer_id, $sum 1, $sum outstanding_amount, $lookup employees for name.

questions.question: Find customers from Karnataka who have a credit score above 750 and have made at least one transaction above ₹1 lakh in the last year.
questions.hint: $match customers state=Karnataka + credit_score>750, get their ids, $match transactions amount>100000 + last year, $group by customer_id, filter ≥1.

questions.question: Which customers have unresolved support tickets AND have had a failed transaction in the past 6 months?
questions.hint: Get customers with open/in_progress tickets. Get customers with failed transactions last 6 months. Intersect. $lookup for names.

questions.question: Show the complete loan + account + customer summary for all defaulted loan customers: customer name, loan amount, outstanding, account balance, account type.
questions.hint: $match loans status=defaulted, $lookup customers on customer_id, $lookup accounts on customer_id (with $unwind and $project).

questions.question: Which branches have more than 50 accounts opened in the last 2 years?
questions.hint: $match opening_date >= 2 years ago, $group by branch_id $sum 1, $match count > 50, $lookup branches.

questions.question: What is the average number of transactions per customer for customers who have both a credit card and a savings account?
questions.hint: Get customer_ids with credit cards, get customer_ids with savings accounts, find intersection, count transactions per customer, take average.

questions.question: For high-risk customers, what is the distribution of their loan statuses?
questions.hint: Get high-risk customer_ids, $lookup loans, $group by loan status, $sum 1.

questions.question: Which merchant has received the highest total payment amount through transactions?
questions.hint: $group transactions by merchant_id $sum amount (exclude null merchant_id), $sort desc, $limit 1, $lookup merchants.

questions.question: Generate a full customer 360 view: for a given customer_id, show their accounts, total transactions, active loans, open tickets, and card count.
questions.hint: Multiple $lookup stages from customers → accounts, transactions, loans, support_tickets, cards. Use $size or $sum to count.
